curriculum.coreConcept: triangle area from two sides and included sine; area ratios from equal altitudes and segment ratios

difficultyRole.rationale: three linked student steps: included-angle triangle area, median area split, segment-ratio area split

directSolution: BM=MC, so triangles ABM and ACM share altitude from A and have equal area; [ABM]=36/2=18 cm².
AD:DB=2:1 gives AD/AB=2/3. Triangles ADM and ABM share altitude from M to AB, so [ADM]/[ABM]=AD/AB=2/3.

existenceAndUniqueness.reason: AB=AC=12 and included angle 30° determine a nondegenerate triangle; M and D are unique from the stated midpoint and ratio conditions.
